title: Gear Retexture
description: Don't like the look of your armor? Drop the material you want and disguise it like another set without affecting its properties!
body:
Easily retexture your armor or tools to what *you* like.

For example, you're wearing Netherite Armor, but you prefer the look of Diamond Armor? Throw the armor and a diamond ontop of an enchanment table and it'll change the look. All of your enchants and naming will be preserved.

Works for all armor types (including the tutle helmet) as well as all tools and weapons.
